purpose: Independent printed-edition comparison candidates for Q0.3 tafsir quality gate

bibliography.work_ar: جامع البيان في تأويل آي القرآن

required: record verse ID and adjacent verses
verify title, edition, editor, publisher, volume, printed page
compare source text boundary with printed page and neighboring commentary
classify intentional continuation vs absent vs possible truncation with evidence
document rights before storing scans or large extracts
prohibited: do not guess or write missing tafsir text using AI
do not publish modern edition text without rights review
do not silently overwrite upstream Tafsir Center records

remarks: Candidate editions are not proof of which edition Tafsir Center actually used.
Published variants and pagination differ; record edition before volume/page citations.
